review:
The Dog House goes to sea – a pirate ship, and clusters instead of lines. On a 5x5 grid, five or more touching symbols win, with pirate dogs and a golden bone on top.

Treasure chest wilds can land any time with multipliers up to 10x for any cluster they join. Paw scatters give up to 20 free spins where those wilds stick, keeping their value to the end. Up to 7,500x. Feels quite different from the line games – worth a try even if you know the originals.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
